rules.scope: Synthetic operational path exercise only; no natural-speech quality, WER or browser-delivery acceptance claim.
rules.routes: Session-summary final_marian_routes and final_gemma_requests are authoritative counts. Per-caption route is derived from tps_a==0 versus positive generation rate, reconciled to those counters and checked against actual recognized text/confidence and the fixed routing predicate. There is no explicit per-caption route field.
rules.confidence: Observed rounded 1+mean-logprob proxy; not a calibrated probability. Conservative admission uses the original runtime value and threshold 0.8. Observations here are safely above the boundary.
rules.matching: Each observed source matches exactly one frozen script after case folding, punctuation removal and whitespace normalization; all 72 match. EN first phrase changes only period to question mark.
rules.percentiles: Raw observations per model/language/policy/phrase; p50 median, p95 nearest-rank ceil(.95*n)-1. Each phrase has 3 observations, so p95 equals its maximum.
rules.code: All runs share recorded core-source/package signatures and startup pipeline hash; packaged VAD version and weight SHA are recorded in each run. This is a post-setup cohort, separate from the 45-second screen.
